**v1.0.3: the bot talks to NPCs again with a smaller UI.**
- **Talking to the quest's NPC**: with the game's UI below full size (0.86 in the report), the "Press X to Talk" panel's name was read garbled (ENGDCERMONTGWRY for Engineer Montgomery). The bot took its own quest NPC for someone else, stood beside him, never pressed X and asked for help. It now reads that name at twice the size and still recognises a garbled read of the NPC it's looking for. Other NPCs beside it (a vendor, another engineer) still get no X.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to anything below v1.0.3, including installs set up from the v0.6.1 and v0.6.2 zips (they show v1.0.1 and v1.0.2). One set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips shows v1.2.0 or v1.2.1 (one run from the code, v1.3.0) and has to be updated once by hand: close the bot, delete version.txt in its folder (usually %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Wiz-Maxxing), then open Wiz-Maxxing (or the tray's Check for updates) and say Yes. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
